clips.title: What Are You Watching With Your Friend?
grammar: 〜てんの — contraction of 〜ているの (what are you doing)
〜ってなって — having come to pass that

lines.en: What are you doing?
lines.speaker: Shin

lines.ja: え？ あの、友達とあのDVD見ようってなって、うん。
lines.en: Huh? Well, um, my friend and I decided to watch a DVD, yeah.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Wait, where is your friend?
lines.speaker: Shin

lines.ja: あ、あの、私の家に先に帰ってる。うん。
lines.en: Ah, um, she went ahead to my place. Yeah.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Oh, is that so?
lines.speaker: Shin

lines.en: Yeah.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: So... you're watching adult videos with your friend?
lines.speaker: Shin

lines.en: Huh?
lines.speaker: Kyoko

clips.title: I Just Wanted to Prepare
grammar: せめて〜だけでも — at least only ~
〜（よ）うと思って — thinking of doing

lines.en: To me,
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: しん君が初めての彼氏だから、
lines.en: Shin-kun is my first boyfriend, so...
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: 明日初めてしん君の家泊まりに行くってなって、
lines.en: When we arranged for me to stay at your place for the first time tomorrow,
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: でも、夜のそういうのしたことないから不安で。
lines.en: I've never done that kind of nighttime stuff, so I was worried.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: だから、せめて予習だけでもしとこうと思って。
lines.en: So, I thought I should at least do some preparation.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: 変な嘘ついてごめんね。
lines.en: I'm sorry for telling such weird lies.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

clips.title: Calling Home to Cancel
grammar: 〜てくんない — won't you do for me (casual)
〜にゃ — colloquial contraction of には

lines.en: Ah, Mom?
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Huh? Why Naoto?
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Why are you picking up, Naoto?
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Huh? Mom's in the bath?
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: あ、じゃ直人、お母さんに言っといてくんない？
lines.en: Ah, well Naoto, could you tell Mom for me?
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: ちょっと今日は帰れないって。
lines.en: That I can't come home today.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Why, you ask?
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.ja: 中学生のあんたにゃまだ分かんないこと。
lines.en: Something a middle schooler like you wouldn't understand yet.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Being an adult woman is tough.
lines.speaker: Kyoko

lines.en: Ah, a woman who is becoming an adult, that is.
lines.speaker: Kyoko
